Hello to late crew,
Slow afternoon behind us, one thing is left: gate queues

Keep this moving with a calm, steady eye for pet travelers who are already juggling bags, documents, and nerves. The goal is to keep the handoff smooth and respectful, so please check every carrier latch, keep the path clear, and remind the ground team to move each crate carefully between services. <<FACT F057>> If someone looks unsure, answer plainly and point them to the next step without piling on extra talk.

For crate checks, stay practical and consistent. <<FACT F070>> If a rabbit crate seems awkward to lift, call for help before it shifts, and make sure the carrier stays level during transfer. The safety coordinator has asked us to keep an eye out for loose bedding, weak fasteners, and any sign that a pet is stressed, because small fixes now prevent bigger problems at the gate.

Thanks for keeping the Companion Animal Travel Desk steady for Aurelia Skyways and for treating each traveler with care. Companion Animal Travel Desk
